title: Feynman Meets Turing: The Curse of Quantum Universality
summary: We consider a formal model of quantum circuit description languages (QCDLs) in which semantically meaningful programs correspond to computable unitary matrices. We show that any semantically universal QCDL -- that is, any QCDL able to describe all computable unitary matrices, which in turn form the set of matrices we can meaningfully represent on digital hardware -- cannot have a semi-decidable set of semantically meaningful descriptions.
